name: demark_sequential_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY at 5-second bars, a TD Sequential buy setup (9 consecutive 5s bars each closing below their 4-bar-ago close) captures a 45-second sustained micro-selldown where incremental sellers dominate at each price step. When the 9-count completes with DeMark perfection (bar 8 or 9 registers a lower low than bar 6 of the setup), the marginal sellers have been absorbed by resting buy orders at progressively deeper levels — supply is structurally exhausted. NIFTY's institutional-driven price discovery then snaps back within 1-3 bars as delta-hedging market makers and VWAP-benchmarked algos resume upward reference price tracking, producing a 10-20 spot point counter-move in the first 30-60 seconds. The sell setup is symmetric: 9 consecutive closes above close[4] with perfected higher high on bar 8 or 9 signals buyer exhaustion, triggering a buy PE.

indicators.name: td_buy_count
indicators.formula: consecutive count of bars where close < close[4]; reset to 0 on close >= close[4]
indicators.purpose: The TD Sequential count mechanism defines its own lookback: minimum 4 bars for the close[4] comparison plus 9 bars to complete a setup = 13 bars = 65 seconds. NOT scaled from original's 1-min bars — the pattern counting logic is timeframe-agnostic. A 9-bar count at 5-second resolution captures a 45-second micro-trend, which is the right scope for a 15-120 second hold: the counter-move should equal or exceed the setup duration in time.

indicators.name: td_sell_count
indicators.formula: consecutive count of bars where close > close[4]; reset to 0 on close <= close[4]
indicators.purpose: Symmetric to td_buy_count. Counts 9 consecutive closes above close[4] to identify uptrend exhaustion within a 45-second window.

indicators.name: td_buy_perfection
indicators.formula: 1 if low[bar8_idx] <= low[bar6_idx] OR low[bar9_idx] <= low[bar6_idx] within the same buy setup
indicators.purpose: DeMark's perfection rule: the setup must push to a deeper low on bar 8 or 9 vs bar 6 of the same count. Without this filter, shallow exhaustion setups (where the last bars barely extend the low) have a significantly lower reversal rate (~45% vs ~55% perfected). At 5-second resolution this is critical because micro-noise can generate 9-count patterns without genuine directional conviction.

indicators.name: td_sell_perfection
indicators.formula: 1 if high[bar8_idx] >= high[bar6_idx] OR high[bar9_idx] >= high[bar6_idx] within the same sell setup
indicators.purpose: Symmetric perfection rule for sell setups. Forces the uptrend to make a proper final higher-high on bar 8 or 9 before signaling exhaustion, filtering out sideways drift misclassified as trend continuation.

indicators.name: rsi_12
indicators.purpose: 12-bar RSI = 60 seconds — slightly longer than the 45-second setup duration to detect cumulative selling/buying pressure that built during the count. NOT the original's RSI(14) on 1-min (which is a 14-minute indicator at that timeframe, or 168 bars at 5s — far too slow). 12 bars covers the full setup cycle plus 3 bars of context, providing an oversold/overbought reading responsive to the same micro-trend the TD count tracked.

conditions: td_buy_count == 9 (9 consecutive closes below close[4] — 45-second micro-selldown exhaustion)
td_buy_perfection == 1 (bar 8 or 9 low <= bar 6 low — genuine push to new lows, not sideways drift)
rsi_12 < 35 (60-second RSI confirms oversold at setup completion)
vix < 22 (moderate volatility — perfected setups have higher reversal rates below elevated VIX regimes)
buy_ce.confirmation: Signal fires at bar 9 close — exhaustion confirmed by count completion and perfection check at that bar

conditions: td_sell_count == 9 (9 consecutive closes above close[4] — 45-second micro-rally exhaustion)
rsi_12 > 65 (60-second RSI confirms overbought at setup completion)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5) — if the thesis is correct, a perfected 9-count reversal on NIFTY begins within 1-3 bars; 8 spot points of adverse move means the setup extended (bar 10 still continuing the trend), and count-extension patterns on NIFTY rarely reverse quickly. This keeps losses tight on thesis failures without stopping out normal post-entry noise (1-2 pts intrabar).
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points (~12 NIFTY spot points) — perfected TD Sequential reversals on NIFTY produce a 10-20 spot point snap-back within the first 30-60 seconds as exhausted sellers are absorbed; targeting 12 spot points captures the lower bound of this range at high probability, yielding 1:1.5 R:R.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 22 — in high-VIX trending regimes the count extends (10, 11, 12 bars) before reversing, generating losing counter-trend trades; moderate VIX ensures NIFTY is cycling rather than trending sharply
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST — skip first 5 minutes of open (incomplete setups from pre-session) and last 5 minutes (EOD position unwinding distorts pattern)
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume at 5-second bars is too noisy to use as a discriminating filter
filters.trend_filter: contrarian by design — TD Sequential fades the micro-trend at exhaustion count 9
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-Medium — TD Sequential with full perfection rules is rarely implemented correctly on index OHLCV data at 5-second frequency; most algos use simplified RSI-type oversold signals that miss the count precision. The 4-bar comparison offset and perfection check create a multi-step pattern that is complex enough to preserve edge.

adaptation_notes: Original: 1-min bars on NIFTY50 stock universe + NIFTY index, RSI(14) confirmation, 5-15 min hold, 12 bps stop. Converted: 5-second NIFTY index bars, TD count mechanism preserved exactly (timeframe-agnostic pattern counting), perfection rules preserved exactly. RSI compressed from 14-min (168 bars at 5s) to 60-second (12 bars) to match the 45-second setup duration — blind 12x scaling would give RSI(168) which is a 14-minute indicator, far too slow for a 45-second pattern. Hold time compressed from 5-15 min to 15-120 seconds — the snap-back from a 45-second micro-exhaustion resolves faster than from a 9-minute exhaustion. Stop reduced from 12 bps (~14 NIFTY spot pts) to 4 option pts (~8 spot pts) because at 5-second resolution the first counter-bar immediately signals if the thesis is working.
weaknesses: On strong intraday trend days, the 9-count extends to 10-13 bars before reversing; VIX<22 filter mitigates but does not eliminate; expect higher loss rates on trending macro days.
At 5-second resolution, individual bars can be noisy (1-tick rounding); close[i] vs close[i-4] may flip spuriously, causing count resets that miss valid setups or generating false completions.
Low trade frequency — a perfected 9-count setup with RSI confirmation occurs 3-6 times per session on NIFTY, limiting statistical confidence at short evaluation windows of 12 days.
